contentItem.title: 等量关系：平行六面体与平行线与线段
contentItem.englishTitle: Parallelepipedal solids which are on the same base and of the same height, and in which the extremities of the sides which stand up are not on the same straight lines, are equal to one another.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: Parallelepipedal solids which are on the same base and of the same height, and in which the extremities of the sides which stand up are not on the same straight lines, are equal to one another.
平行管道固体,在同一底边高度,站立两侧的极限不在同一直线上,是等同的。

Let CM, CN be parallelepipedal solids on the same base AB and of the same height, and let the extremities of their sides which stand up, namely AF, AG, LM, LN, CD, CE, BH, BK, not be on the same straight lines; I say that the solid CM is equal to the solid CN.
让同一底边 AB和同一高度的CM CN平行管道固体,让它们站立的两侧的极限,即AF、AG、LM、LN、CD、CE、BH、BK,不要在同一直线上;我说,固体CM等于固体CN。
For let NK, DH be produced and meet one another at R, and further let FM, GE be produced to P, Q; let AO, LP, CQ, BR be joined.
NK,DH延长,R相互交错,FM,GE延长到P,Q;AO,LP,CQ,BR连通。

Then the solid CM, of which the parallelogram ACBL is the base, and FDHM its opposite, is equal to the solid CP, of which the parallelogram ACBL is the base, and OQRP its opposite; for they are on the same base ACBL and of the same height, and the extremities of their sides which stand up, namely AF, AO, LM, LP, CD, CQ, BH, BR, are on the same straight lines FP, DR. [[XI. 29](/principles/euclid-11-29)]
CM固体,其中平行四边形 ACBL为底边,FDHM为FDHM,等于CP固体,其中平行四边形 ACBL为底边,OQRP为OQRP;由于它们身高相同,为底边 ACBL,身高相同,两侧的高度相同,即AF、AO、LM、LP、CD、CQ、BH、BR线相同。（相关点与线段：FP、DR） [[XI. 29](/principles/euclid-11-29)]

But the solid CP, of which the parallelogram ACBL is the base, and OQRP its opposite, is equal to the solid CN, of which the parallelogram ACBL is the base and GEKN its opposite; for they are again on the same base ACBL and of the same height, and the extremities of their sides which stand up, namely AG, AO, CE, CQ, LN, LP, BK, BR, are on the same straight lines GQ, NR.
但CP固体,其中平行四边形 ACBL为底边,OQRP为CN,等于CN固体,其中平行四边形 ACBL为底边和GEKN为底边,GEKN为GEKN;由于它们重重合底边 ACBL,身高相同,两侧的高度相同,即AG、AO、CE、CQ、LN、LP、BK、BR线相同。（相关点与线段：GQ、NR）
Hence the solid CM is also equal to the solid CN.
